no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the OXERVATE (BLA761094) approval. The Medical Review states plainly that no Advisory Committee Meeting was held, and the Summary Review explains that the application did not raise any new efficacy or safety issues warranting AC discussion, noting that complete clearing of the cornea surface is a well-established endpoint and the adverse events were consistent with the disease. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
